name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Round 1
domainSummary: An identity-only Column Technologies project landmark whose public-safe concept may suggest continuity, redundancy, protected service, recovery, and durable operation without claiming an actual Atlassian deployment.
evidenceBoundary: The project name is the only factual source. Do not depict Atlassian products, topology, incidents, metrics, real architecture, or skill links.

researchSources.title: Career World production inventory
researchSources.use: Approved identity-only boundary for ACE and Column projects.

researchSources.title: Canonical art brief
researchSources.use: Accepted U-shaped fortified identity and explicit factual prohibitions.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Canonical Amplification
assets.controlledVariable: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette; emphasize service continuity
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested at its most resolved supporting-landmark scale. This version emphasizes service continuity.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Process Spine
assets.controlledVariable: recompose the landmark along a clear sequential service spine with repeated but unequal chambers; emphasize redundant support paths
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: A visible spatial sequence makes the project's process legible without arrows or diagrams. This version emphasizes redundant support paths.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Exchange Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: divide the major functions into unequal connected masses joined by one inhabited structural bridge; emphasize protected core
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: A physical bridge tests whether handoff and exchange should dominate the identity. This version emphasizes protected core.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Checkpoint Court
assets.controlledVariable: organize the building around a protected validation court with layered thresholds and one decisive exit; emphasize recoverable operation
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: A central court makes review, validation, or adjudication the primary metaphor. This version emphasizes recoverable operation.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Terraced Escalation
assets.controlledVariable: step the landmark upward through three or four connected terraces toward one compact focus; emphasize durable shared infrastructure
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: Terraced hierarchy expresses staged progress and increasing commitment. This version emphasizes durable shared infrastructure.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Modular Batch
assets.controlledVariable: build the landmark from repeatable unequal modules locked to one continuous service base; emphasize service continuity
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: Repeatable modules test batch, scale, and replaceability without detached pieces. This version emphasizes service continuity.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Guarded Recovery
assets.controlledVariable: place a protected core inside redundant connected routes with one visibly joined recovery annex; emphasize redundant support paths
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: Guardrails and recovery become architectural without implying an unverified implementation. This version emphasizes redundant support paths.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Asymmetric Landmark
assets.controlledVariable: concentrate height and mass off-center to create one singular project-scale skyline; emphasize protected core
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: A deliberately asymmetric silhouette tests recognition at map scale. This version emphasizes protected core.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Compact Deployment
assets.controlledVariable: compress the domain into the smallest dense, coherent project building that retains the accepted identity; emphasize recoverable operation
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: Compression tests which visual cues are essential rather than merely decorative. This version emphasizes recoverable operation.

assets.name: Atlassian Data Center Resilience · Domain Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance the strongest baseline, process, validation, exchange, and recovery cues in one resolved composition; emphasize durable shared infrastructure
assets.parentConcept: Atlassian Data Center Resilience research profile
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a mature all-around project identity without becoming a city capital. This version emphasizes durable shared infrastructure.
